progress.command:
set -e
command -v tmux >/dev/null
ROOT=$(mktemp -d /tmp/pit-raw-XXXXXX); mkdir -p $ROOT/home $ROOT/agent $ROOT/work
echo $ROOT > /tmp/pit-raw-root
S=$ROOT/tmux.sock
NODE=$(dirname "$(command -v node)")
CMD="env -i PATH=$NODE:/usr/bin:/bin HOME=$ROOT/home PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR=$ROOT/agent TERM=xterm-256color LANG=C.UTF-8 PI_OFFLINE=1 PI_TELEMETRY=0 node $PWD/node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent/dist/bundle/cli.js -ne -e $PWD/src/index.ts -e $PWD/test/support/raw-call-provider.js --no-skills --no-context-files --no-prompt-templates --offline --provider raw-fixture --model fixture --session-dir $ROOT/sessions; exec sleep 86400"
cd $ROOT/work
tmux -S $S -f /dev/null new-session -d -s raw -x 110 -y 45 "$CMD"
sleep 6
tmux -S $S send-keys -t raw "run options fixture" Enter
sleep 6
tmux -S $S capture-pane -p -t raw | sed -e 's/[[:space:]]*$//' | grep -v '^$' | tail -30
